clients.title: Clients
clients.description: The people and companies you build for. Assign a client to a project and enable the client portal in the project's settings.

empty.title: No clients yet
empty.body: Add the people or companies you build for. You can then invite them to a read-only portal for their projects.

form.name: Name
form.internalNotesHint: Internal notes, never shown to the client.

detail.archivedNotice: This client is archived. It is hidden from project assignment until you restore it.
detail.projectsHint: Assign a client to a project and enable the client portal in the project's settings.
detail.projectsEmpty: No projects are assigned to this client yet.
detail.portalUsersHint: People who accepted an invitation. They can only see projects with the portal enabled.
detail.portalUsersEmpty: Nobody has joined the portal yet. Send an invitation below.
detail.removeBody: {name} will no longer see this client's projects. Their account stays; you can invite them again later.
detail.inviteOnce: Copy this link now. It is shown only once, works one time and expires in 7 days.
detail.inviteEmailed: We also emailed the link to {email}.
detail.inviteNotEmailed: Email is not configured, so send the link yourself.
detail.revokeBody: The link sent to {email} will stop working.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Every invoice across your projects. Create and send invoices from a project's billing page.
invoices.emptyBody: Invoices you create in a project's billing page appear here.
invoices.caption: Invoices

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Payments recorded across your projects. To void a payment, open the project's billing page.
payments.emptyBody: Payments you record against invoices appear here.
payments.caption: Payments

workspaceMode.title: Workspace mode
workspaceMode.description: Choose how much of the workspace you see. You can switch at any time; nothing is deleted.
workspaceMode.simpleBody: Shows clients, projects, invoices and payments.
workspaceMode.advancedBody: Adds activity, AI models, agents, integrations and technical project pages.
